>
[Growing Eel Friend](/Feats.aspx?ID=5282) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 19

**Prerequisites**
[Elver Pet](/Feats.aspx?ID=5277)

</column>

---

Your eel pet grows larger and stronger. Your eel pet's size changes to Small, and the eel gains the [scent](/Familiars.aspx?ID=147) and [tough](/Familiars.aspx?ID=148) pet abilities. However, it becomes too large to carry in a water-filled globe.
